publisher.name: federation-port prototype (refund-execution/0.1 envelope profile, local only)

check_evidence.description: UTF-8 JSON {input: aps-action-ref-v2 input, approval: aps-receipt-v1 aps:policy-decision:v1} for the nested arguments tuple

output_evidence.description: The input evidence bytes, returned unmodified

claims.establishes: action.args is a refund-execution/0.1 handoff with exactly the profile's fields, tool refund, and nested arguments payment_id, currency and integer amount_minor of at least 1.
limits: Shape only; says nothing about who produced the handoff

claims.establishes: The handoff operation_id equals the port operation id being admitted.
The handoff approval_ref equals the approval id the runtime will consume.
limits: Equality of labels only; the approval itself is checked by the aps.* claims

claims.establishes: The handoff carries an aps_evidence_ref that is a printable ASCII string of 1 to 256 characters.
limits: A reference, not verified content; it is not resolved or compared with the APS evidence bytes
Bound to the operation only because it is part of the action digest

claims.establishes: The approval is a valid aps:policy-decision:v1 receipt signed by a key the customer policy trusts for the configured boundary identity.
limits: Key possession only; says nothing about the signer's general trustworthiness
The predecessor action-intent receipt is not verified

claims.establishes: The receipt_id of the presented approval equals the approval_id the runtime will consume.
limits: Does not check whether the approval was already used; that is the runtime's consumption record
narrow decisions are reported unsupported because constraints are not evaluated

claims.establishes: The nested arguments tuple and its target recompute to the approval's aps-action-ref-v2 digest under the exact-refund profile.
limits: Covers the nested tuple only, not the outer handoff fields
Exact profile only, not a ceiling
Target template is candidate profile text, not a published profile
JSON.parse does not refuse duplicate member names

claims.establishes: The evaluation instant is not after the decision's valid_until.
limits: Uses the runtime clock; no trusted time source

claims.establishes: Never established by this component: PIC verification is not implemented.
limits: Always reported not_established with a reason
pic_evidence_ref is carried and bound to the operation through the action digest but never resolved or verified

profiles.description: action.args is the full handoff. Linkage to the port operation and approval, and APS authority over the nested arguments tuple only.

keys.purpose: Verification of approval signatures; public keys resolved from customer policy config. Synthetic in tests.
keys.lifecycle: Rotated by the customer policy; no key ids are embedded in this component

license.attribution: Local prototype, not distributed. Uses agent-passport-system 7.2.1 (Apache-2.0)
